_descriptions.env.CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER: Disables attribution headers in generated code
_descriptions.env.CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT: Disables 1M token long-context window to reduce latency/cost
_descriptions.env.CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY: Prevents auto-storing and recalling info across sessions
_descriptions.env.CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRA: Disables telemetry, background updates, non-critical network requests
_descriptions.env.CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE: Stops dynamic terminal window title updates
_descriptions.env.DISABLE_EXTRA_USAGE_COMMAND: Disables usage tracking and statistics commands
_descriptions.env.CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE_SYSTEM_PROMPT: Uses concise system prompt instead of full detailed version
_descriptions.effortLevel: AI reasoning effort — higher = better quality, slower response
_descriptions.editorMode: Editor keybindings for Claude Code's built-in editing
_descriptions.autoConnectIde: Auto-connect to running IDE (VS Code, etc.)
_descriptions.autoMemoryEnabled: Enable automatic memory storage across sessions
_descriptions.awaySummaryEnabled: Summarize activity while terminal was inactive
_descriptions.showClearContextOnPlanAccept: Prompt to clear context when accepting a plan
_descriptions.includeCoAuthoredBy: Add Co-authored-by tag to git commits
_descriptions.includeGitInstructions: Include git-related instructions in AI responses

token-efficient.name: Token Efficient
token-efficient.description: Minimizes token usage — disables auto-memory, telemetry, long context, usage stats. Vim mode, xhigh effort.
